requirements.text: A new bookmark shall be added into a specific location within the bookmarks hierarchy.
Bookmarks shall be properly deleted from bookmarks file and no longer be displayed  from all access points.
Bookmarks shall be added and deleted from the personal toolbar.
New bookmark folder shall be inserted into the bookmarks hierarchy.
Double-clicking on a bookmark shall cause it to be launched in a browser window.
Bookmarks within the default bookmarks file that is packaged with the browser shall be valid links.
Changes to a bookmark item shall be saved without loss of item integrity.
Bookmarks separators shall be added and deleted.
Bookmarks changes shall be saved over restart/crash.
View properties shall execute for bookmarks, folders, and separators(negative).
Bookmarks shall be renamed "inline", i.e. without having to use the bookmarks properties dialog.
Bookmarks shall be found using user-defined custom keyword.
Bookmarks shall be sorted and reverse-sorted per column.
Bookmark columns shall be resizable to show/hide more of entries.
Bookmark columns shall be showed and hidden.
Several bookmarks shall be deleted at one time.
It shall be not possible to drop a bookmark item onto itself or its immediate parent or child.

generated_cases.title: Add bookmark to a specific nested location
generated_cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark can be successfully added into a specific nested folder within the bookmarks hierarchy.

generated_cases.title: Add bookmark to root location
generated_cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark can be added directly to the root location of the bookmarks hierarchy.

generated_cases.title: Attempt to add bookmark to a non-existent location
generated_cases.description: Verify that attempting to add a bookmark to a non-existent or invalid location ID fails gracefully or defaults safely.

generated_cases.title: Delete single bookmark from storage and UI
generated_cases.description: Verify that deleting a bookmark successfully removes it from the bookmarks file and ensures it is no longer displayed from any access points (Bookmarks Manager, Menu, and Toolbar).

generated_cases.title: Verify no orphaned references after bookmark deletion
generated_cases.description: Verify that when a bookmark is deleted, no dangling or orphaned entries or file corruption remain in the bookmarks storage file.

generated_cases.title: Add and Delete Bookmark via Personal Toolbar
generated_cases.description: Verify that bookmarks can be successfully added to the personal toolbar and subsequently deleted, ensuring they appear and disappear correctly from the toolbar UI.

generated_cases.title: Negative Test for Personal Toolbar Item Addition
generated_cases.description: Verify that dropping invalid data types or unsupported elements onto the personal toolbar is prevented and does not result in malformed toolbar entries.

generated_cases.title: Insert new bookmark folder into hierarchy
generated_cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark folder can be successfully inserted into a specific location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

generated_cases.title: Insert bookmark folder with duplicate name
generated_cases.description: Verify the system behavior when attempting to insert a new bookmark folder with a name that already exists within the same parent folder (boundary and abnormal path).

generated_cases.title: Launch valid bookmark in browser window via double-click
generated_cases.description: Verify that double-clicking on a bookmark with a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL causes it to be successfully launched and opened in a browser window.

generated_cases.title: Double-clicking on a bookmark with a malformed or empty URL
generated_cases.description: Verify the application behavior when double-clicking a bookmark with an empty URL string or a malformed URL, ensuring proper error handling or rejection without crashing the browser.

generated_cases.title: Default packaged bookmarks link validity check
generated_cases.description: Verify that all bookmarks within the default bookmarks file packaged with the browser contain valid, reachable URLs returning successful HTTP status codes.

generated_cases.title: Default bookmarks broken link handling
generated_cases.description: Verify that any broken or expired links (returning HTTP 404/500 responses) within the default bookmarks file are properly identified during validation checks.

generated_cases.title: Save changes to bookmark item successfully
generated_cases.description: Verify that editing a bookmark's title and URL and saving the changes updates the bookmark correctly without loss of item integrity.

generated_cases.title: Save bookmark changes with extreme character lengths
generated_cases.description: Verify that editing bookmark properties with maximum character limits and special characters saves successfully without data corruption.

generated_cases.title: Handle abrupt interruption during bookmark save operation
generated_cases.description: Verify the system behavior when a bookmark save operation is interrupted by an abrupt termination, ensuring item integrity or graceful recovery.

generated_cases.title: Delete Empty Bookmarks Folder
generated_cases.description: Verify that an empty bookmarks folder can be successfully deleted from the bookmarks hierarchy and is removed from storage and UI access points.

generated_cases.title: Delete Non-Empty Bookmarks Folder with Contents
generated_cases.description: Verify that deleting a bookmarks folder containing nested bookmarks and subfolders correctly removes the folder along with all its descendant items.

generated_cases.title: Negative Test: Delete Locked or Read-Only Bookmarks Folder
generated_cases.description: Verify that attempting to delete a bookmarks folder that is locked or marked as read-only fails gracefully with an appropriate error message and leaves the folder intact.

generated_cases.title: Add and Delete Bookmark Separators
generated_cases.description: Verify that bookmarks separators can be successfully added between bookmarks in the hierarchy and subsequently deleted without affecting adjacent bookmark items.

generated_cases.title: Delete Non-Existent Separator Negative Test
generated_cases.description: Verify the system handles attempts to delete non-existent separators gracefully without crashing or altering existing bookmark structures.

generated_cases.title: Persistence after graceful browser restart
generated_cases.description: Verify that all changes made to bookmarks (additions, deletions, edits, and folder creations) persist correctly after a graceful shutdown and normal browser restart.

generated_cases.title: Persistence after sudden browser crash
generated_cases.description: Verify that bookmark changes remain intact and do not result in database corruption or data loss when the browser experiences an abrupt, unexpected crash.

generated_cases.title: Verify view properties negative behavior for bookmarks, folders, and separators
generated_cases.description: Attempt to access or invoke unsupported view properties for bookmarks, folders, and separators, ensuring that the system correctly rejects the action or triggers the expected negative state.

generated_cases.title: Inline rename bookmark normal path
generated_cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be renamed directly inline within the UI without opening the bookmarks properties dialog by clicking the name, modifying the text, and committing the change.

generated_cases.title: Inline rename bookmark boundary and abort path
generated_cases.description: Verify inline renaming behavior when handling character limit boundaries and when clicking away or losing focus without explicitly committing changes.

generated_cases.title: Resolve bookmark via custom keyword
generated_cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be successfully found and opened in the browser by entering its user-defined custom keyword in the address bar.

generated_cases.title: Keyword search with special characters and case sensitivity
generated_cases.description: Verify the behavior of custom keywords containing special characters or distinct letter casing to ensure accurate retrieval.

generated_cases.title: Handle non-existent or duplicate keywords (Negative)
generated_cases.description: Verify that searching with an unregistered keyword or handling duplicate keywords appropriately falls back to standard search or displays an error/warning.

generated_cases.title: Sort and reverse-sort bookmark columns
generated_cases.description: Verify that bookmarks can be successfully sorted in ascending and descending order per column by clicking the column headers.

generated_cases.title: Sort columns with special characters and empty values
generated_cases.description: Verify column sorting handles boundary conditions such as empty fields or special characters correctly without failing.

generated_cases.title: Resize bookmark columns to show and hide more entries
generated_cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be successfully resized by dragging the column divider to show or hide more of the entry text.

generated_cases.title: Boundary test for bookmark column width limits
generated_cases.description: Verify the behavior of bookmark columns when resized to their minimum and maximum allowed widths, ensuring entries remain handled properly without collapsing completely.

generated_cases.title: Show and Hide Bookmark Columns
generated_cases.description: Verify that individual bookmark columns can be successfully shown and hidden using the column configuration interface or context menu.

generated_cases.title: Prevent Hiding All Columns Simultaneously
generated_cases.description: Verify the boundary behavior ensuring that hiding all columns simultaneously is prevented, maintaining a minimum required set of visible columns.

generated_cases.title: Batch Deletion of Multiple Bookmarks
generated_cases.description: Verify that several bookmarks can be selected and deleted at one time from the bookmarks manager, ensuring all selected items are removed from storage and UI.

generated_cases.title: Batch Deletion Boundary and Concurrent Modification
generated_cases.description: Verify batch deletion handling under boundary conditions such as deleting zero items versus a very large batch, and ensure robustness against concurrent modifications during deletion.

generated_cases.title: Prevent dropping a bookmark onto itself
generated_cases.description: Verify that attempting to drag and drop a bookmark item onto itself within the bookmarks hierarchy is blocked and does not alter the tree structure.

generated_cases.title: Prevent dropping a bookmark onto its immediate parent
generated_cases.description: Verify that attempting to drag and drop a bookmark item onto its immediate parent folder is rejected with a visual restriction indicator and maintains the original hierarchy.

generated_cases.title: Prevent dropping a bookmark onto its immediate child
generated_cases.description: Verify that attempting to drag and drop a parent bookmark item or folder onto its immediate child node is prevented to avoid circular references and structural corruption.

reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. You must have a bookmarks file.
2. To promote consistency, you may choose to use the default set of Netscape Seamonkey Bookmarks, which I use. I have also provided the default Mozilla bookmarks file.
3. You also have the option to use this very large bookmarks file.
4. You must also customize your sidebar to include a bookmarks panel.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION

reference_cases.title: TC-014
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. Install this bookmarks file.(abcdbookmarks.html)
2. You must also customize your sidebar to include a bookmarks panel.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Select Bookmarks|Manage Bookmarks.
2. Click on the "Name" column once.
3. Click on the "Name" column a second time.
4. Click on the "Name" column a third time.
5. Click on the "URL" column once, and a second time.
6. Click on the "Custom Keyword" column once, and a second time.
7. Click on the "Description" column once, and a second time.
8. Click on the "Last Visit" column once, and a second time.
9. Click on the "Added On" column once, and a second time.
10. Click on the "Last Modified" column once, and a second time.

EXPECTED RESULTSBy step
1. The bookmarks should sort into alphabetical order. (a-b-c-d-e)
2. The bookmarks should sort into reverse-alphabetical order. (e-d-c-b-a)
3. The bookmarks should sort into "natural" order (the way they were originally sorted). (a-d-e-b-c)
4. The bookmarks should sort into order by URL and then the reverse of that order. (d-a-b-c-e)
5. The bookmarks should sort into order by Custom Keyword and then the reverse of that order. (c-d-a-b-e)
6. The bookmarks should sort into order by Description and then the reverse of that order. (b-c-d-a-e)
7. The bookmarks should sort into order by Last Visited time and then the reverse of that order.
8. The bookmarks should sort into order by Added On date and then the reverse of that order.
9. The bookmarks should sort into order by Last Modified date and then the reverse of that order.
10. Separators should separate the sort as well, ie step one should result in a-b-c-d-e|aa-bb-cc-dd-ee, not a-aa-b-bb-c-cc-d-dd-e|.

LINKS
1. netscape-bookmarks.html
2. mozilla-bookmarks.html
3. large-bookmarks.html

INITIAL CONDITIONS
